components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button used throughout channels, drawers, and forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #343832; border-radius: 2px; padding: 7px 10px; background: #f4f0e5; box-shadow: 1px 2px 0 rgba(52, 56, 50, 0.32); color: #222521; font: 600 11px/1.2 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #171a17; background: #fffdf7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd7725; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Icon Action Button
components.description: Icon-only quick action (start/stop/restart/logs, and maintenance actions) with a tooltip and accessible label.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="View logs" data-tooltip="View logs"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 5h14v14H5Z"/><path d="m8 9 2 2-2 2m4 1h4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #334d63; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn::after { content: attr(data-tooltip); position: absolute; z-index: 80; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 7px); width: max-content; max-width: 190px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #0f110f; border-radius: 2px; background: #252925; color: #fffdf7; font: 11px/1.25 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 3px 5px 14px rgba(32, 31, 27, 0.35); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-icon-btn:hover::after, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: A 9px circular indicator LED whose color encodes running/starting/crashed/stopped state; always paired with a text state label.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 20, 17, 0.75); border-radius: 50%; background: #7c7e76; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); } .ds-lamp-running { background: #738644; } .ds-lamp-starting { background: #bd7725; } .ds-lamp-crashed { background: #a43e32; } .ds-lamp-stopped { background: #85867f; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Project search / branch combobox input with an underline-glow focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #8c897e; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 10px; background: #f4f0e5; color: #70756d; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #343832; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #64703a; color: #222521; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; padding: 7px 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 13px/1.3 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Dark pill-strip primary navigation with a light active tab.
components.html: Control boardSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid #111310; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px; background: #191c19; } .ds-nav-link { border-radius: 2px; padding: 7px 10px; color: #adafa5; font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fffdf7; } .ds-nav-link.active { background: #ddd9cd; color: #222521; box-shadow: 1px 2px 0 #0d0f0d; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd7725; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Channel Row
components.description: The core signature unit: a compact multi-column channel row (lamp, identity, branch, route, state, chevron) with always-visible quick actions.
components.css: .ds-channel { border: 1px solid #343832; border-radius: 3px; background: #f4f0e5; box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 rgba(52, 56, 50, 0.26); } .ds-channel-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px minmax(180px, 1.15fr) minmax(150px, 0.8fr) minmax(180px, 1fr) minmax(88px, 0.5fr) 18px; gap: 13px; align-items: center; width: 100%; border: 0; padding: 8px 10px 8px 13px; background: transparent; color: #222521; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-channel-toggle:hover { background: #eeeadf; } .ds-channel-id strong { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-channel-id small, .ds-channel-datum small, .ds-channel-state small { display: block; color: #70756d; font: 9px/1.1 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-channel-datum strong { font: 11px/1.3 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-channel-state strong { color: #4c514b; font: 700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Porto reads as a piece of painted-metal broadcast equipment, not a web dashboard: a fleet signal rail, engraved channel labels, physical-feeling status lamps, and a service drawer that racks open in place. The thesis is one dense process-control board, not a collection of cards — every project is a compact channel strip in a fixed, ranked stack, and the first viewport is a dark control header, a fleet signal rail, a filter strip, and ranked channels with no oversized summary blocks. The palette is putty, graphite, olive, amber, and fault red: warm neutral metal tones carrying three status colors that never wander from their operational meaning.

The story order is deliberate: read fleet health first (the fleet rail's four lamp counters), find the affected project (status lamp + name in the channel row), act immediately (four always-visible quick actions per channel), then expand in place for branch, routing, maintenance, and logs. Nothing about the layout is decorative — gaps, radii, and shadows all read as hardware fit-and-finish rather than software polish.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, single-column ranked channel stack; no card grid, no oversized hero or summary tiles.
Dark graphite control surfaces (header, fleet rail, log console) bracket putty/panel-toned working surfaces.
Status meaning is carried by exactly three signal colors: olive (healthy), amber (in-progress/attention), fault red (crashed/destructive).
Monospace, uppercase, letter-spaced labels everywhere data or state is reported — the "engraved label" language.
Flat hardware surfaces with hard-offset "printed" shadows at rest; soft ambient shadows are reserved for things that lift off the surface (header bar, expanded channel, open menus, tooltips).

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only olive, amber, and fault red carry operational meaning (healthy, in-progress, fault). No other hue is introduced for status; a link uses a desaturated blue-gray (#334d63) precisely so it never competes with the signal vocabulary.

rules.name: The Metal-Not-Paper Rule
rules.body: All panel surfaces stay inside the putty→panel-raised→panel-graphite family. Pure white (Panel White) is reserved for text-on-dark and transient hover states, never a resting page or panel background.

rules.name: The Engraved Label Rule
rules.body: Any text describing a machine fact (branch, port, PID, state, route, timestamp, command) is rendered in uppercase, letter-spaced mono at 9–11px. Prose and proper names stay in sans. Mixing the two inside one string is the signal that something is a live readout, not copy.

rules.name: The Fused Instrument Rule
rules.body: The fleet rail and control bar never separate into two visually distinct cards — they are one header instrument with a dark reporting row on top and a lighter control row beneath.

rules.name: The Printed Edge Rule
rules.body: Flat surfaces at rest use a hard, unblurred offset shadow (a "printed" edge), never a soft blur. Soft blurred shadows are earned only by elements that pop open or float: the header, an expanded drawer, a dropdown, a tooltip.

rules.name: The Sharp Metal Rule
rules.body: No radius in the system exceeds 4px. A rounder corner reads as software chrome, not painted equipment, and breaks the world.

dos: Do keep the fleet rail and control bar fused as one instrument (no gap, rail's bottom radius squared into the bar's top).
Do reserve olive/amber/fault-red exclusively for health/progress/fault meaning; use the desaturated blue-gray for links instead of introducing a fourth signal hue.
Do use hard, unblurred "printed" offset shadows on resting surfaces; reserve soft ambient shadows for elements that open, lift, or float (header, expanded drawer, menus, tooltips).
Do render machine-reported values (branch, port, PID, state, timestamps, commands) in uppercase, letter-spaced mono; keep prose and proper names in sans.
Do expand project detail inline in a serviceDrawer beneath its channel row, never in a modal, side panel, or separate route.
Do give every icon-only control an aria-label, a visible tooltip, and visually-hidden text.
donts: Don't turn project channels into a card grid with generous whitespace — the system is a dense, single-column, fixed-rank stack.
Don't use a border radius greater than 4px anywhere; rounder corners break the painted-metal/mechanical read.

Don't add decorative or looping motion; the only animation is a ~150–220ms reveal/rotate on state changes (banner-in, drawer-reveal, chevron rotation, tooltip fade), all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't hide a project's state behind an icon alone — the status lamp always pairs with a text state label.
Don't introduce a fourth accent color for status; if a new state is needed, map it onto olive/amber/fault-red rather than adding a hue.
